about: Geography of the Palimpsest taxa. All codes are WGSRPD level-3 botanical countries.

match.note: WCVP covers vascular plants only; the unmatched taxa are mosses, liverworts, algae, lichens and fungi.

files.regions.topo.json: TopoJSON, object 'regions': WGSRPD level-3 units drawn from Natural Earth admin-1 (lon/lat, simplified); properties id, name, l2, l1, lon, lat, approx; 'points' lists units too small to draw
files.regions-globe.topo.json: The same units, coarser (0.4 degree tolerance), for the turning globe
files.regions.json: The 369 units without geometry: id, name, level-2 and level-1 codes and names, label point, approx, iou (overlap of the drawn Natural Earth units with the WGSRPD extent)
files.../../../../data/processed/geo/wgsrpd_ne: In the repository: every Natural Earth admin-1 unit, the WGSRPD level-3 unit it was assigned to and how (location, iso, nearest), with split-off parts
files.overview.json: Per unit: species of Dioscorides, Culpeper and both native there, top plants, and the computed insights
files.ranges.json: Every taxon (by explorer slug): WCVP match method and native / introduced codes
files.taxa/<slug>.json: One taxon: WCVP name and match, native / introduced / doubtful / extinct codes, a plain sentence, and GBIF occurrence counts on a 2.8125-degree grid (cells = [lon, lat, count] at cell centres)

licences.regions: Boundaries: Natural Earth (public domain); botanical-country units after TDWG WGSRPD (Brummitt 2001), drawn approximately. Crosswalk: data/processed/geo/wgsrpd_ne_crosswalk.csv

cite: Govaerts R (ed.). 2026. WCVP: World Checklist of Vascular Plants. Facilitated by the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. [WWW document] URL https://doi.org/10.34885/egs6-cp24 [accessed 04 Jun 2026]. Licensed under CC BY 3.0.
GBIF.org (2026). Occurrence density, GBIF maps API v2, accessed 2026-11-08. CC BY 4.0.

Boundaries: Natural Earth 1:10m admin-1, v5.1 (public domain); botanical-country units after TDWG WGSRPD (Brummitt RK 2001, World Geographical Scheme for Recording Plant Distributions, ed. 2), drawn approximately.
rules: Species rank only in counts; native = WCVP introduced 0, not extinct, not doubtful; genus-rank taxa map the union of their accepted species.
